name: A Man
overview: Scripture reveals that man was created by God in His own image, endowed with dominion over the earth and all living creatures, emphasizing the unique worth and responsibility of humanity (Genesis 1:26-27). Man’s formation from the dust and the breath of life from God highlight his dependence on the Creator for true life (Genesis 2:7). The Bible also underscores the importance of a man’s character and faithfulness, noting the rarity of genuine integrity (Proverbs 20:6) and the covenant of purity a man should uphold (Job 31:1). Although God made man upright, human beings have often pursued their own devices, revealing the ongoing struggle to live according to God's design (Ecclesiastes 7:29).
